name: Jagatjit Industries Limited
about: Jagatjit Industries Limited manufactures and sale of liquor products in India and internationally. It operates through Beverages, Food, Distillery (Ethanol), and Others segments. Its products include bottled Indian made foreign liquor, country liquor, industrial alcohol, sanitizers, and licensing use of its IMFL brands. The company offers whiskies, gin, rum, brandy, scotch, and vodka under the Aristocrat Premium Old, Aristocrat Premium, Royal Medallion, AC Black, Royal Pride, Damn Good Scotch, IICE Vodka, Aristocrat Dry Gin, and King Henry VIII brands. It also provides dairy products, such as milk powder, dairy whitener, baby food, malt extract powder, malted milk food, and clarified butter; milk and malt food extract products; and malt spirit. In addition, the company trades in petroleum products; manufacturing and supplies food products; and manufactures ethanol and sales to oil marketing companies. Jagatjit Industries Limited was incorporated in 1944 and is based in New Delhi, India.
